v.capitalAtRiskDisclosure: No capital is at risk anywhere in this pipeline: MiniBench entry is free, and the only cost is compute/time paid through the existing free-inference rails (see scripts/gather-question-evidence.mjs's free-first dispatch, verified live in this session's real demo run against the gemini-direct free tier). This is measured from the actual pipeline built here, not merely asserted: no script in this package ever holds, transfers, or places at risk any monetary capital or market position -- forecasting-cli.mjs's full run path is ingest to gather to fuse to record, with no purchase, order, or position anywhere in that chain.
